name: DPM++3M-SDE with cosine eta anneal
tagline: DPM-Solver++(3M) SDE on Karras sigmas, but eta cosine-anneals from 1.5 down to 0.5 across the 20 steps to balance early diversity and late detail.
init_recovers: DPM++3M SDE (eta=1.2) at the trajectory midpoint
diff_from_baseline: Same DPM++3M SDE multistep update as the dpm3m_sde baseline, but replaces the constant eta=1.2 with a cosine schedule running from 1.5 to 0.5 over the steps, applied to both SD and SDXL.

name: DPM++3M-SDE with adaptive eta
tagline: DPM-Solver++(3M) SDE that scales eta by the relative change in consecutive denoised estimates so noise injection grows when the trajectory is changing rapidly.

key_hyperparams.name: alpha
key_hyperparams.role: sensitivity of eta to denoised change

init_recovers: DPM++3M SDE baseline at i=0 (no history)
diff_from_baseline: Wraps the DPM++3M SDE baseline with a per-step adaptive eta proportional to the relative L2 change in successive denoised predictions, instead of the fixed eta=1.2.

name: Noise-First DPM++3M (NF-3M)
tagline: Pre-injects the SDE Langevin noise into the latent before each denoiser call, then runs a deterministic third-order multistep update with closed-form phi-functions.

key_hyperparams.name: taylor_eps
key_hyperparams.role: switch threshold for closed-form vs. Taylor expansion of phi

diff_from_baseline: Restructures the dpm3m_sde baseline so noise is injected before denoising (predictor pre-noised at sigma_hat) and the multistep update uses cleanly separated $\Phi_1,\Phi_2$ functions with stable Taylor fallback for small steps.

name: Deterministic DPM++3M (no churn)
tagline: DPM-Solver++(3M) multistep on Karras sigmas with eta=0; pure ODE solver, three orders of multistep correction, decodes the final denoised estimate.
diff_from_baseline: Strips the Langevin noise from the dpm3m_sde baseline (eta=0), giving a deterministic third-order ODE solver instead of the SDE; otherwise identical multistep recurrence and Karras sigmas.

name: DPM++3M SDE + 4th-order Newton
tagline: DPM++3M SDE with Karras rho=9, sigmoid-ramped eta, and a 4th-order Newton-divided-difference correction using three history denoised values.
init_recovers: DPM++3M SDE baseline at order ≤ 3 and eta=1.2
diff_from_baseline: Extends the dpm3m_sde baseline with a 4th-order Newton-form correction, a sigma-dependent eta that drops by 4x near the end of sampling, and a finer rho=9 Karras schedule.
